name: Fuji Die Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fuji Die Co.,Ltd. produces hard, wear-resistant tools for customers at home and abroad, working with cemented carbide, tungsten carbide and similar materials. Its parts serve metalworking, precision processing and machining. The catalog covers numerous dies and punches for uses such as drawing, extrusion, can making, forging and blanking, plus forming and rolling elements and mandrels.
